function: DNN actor selects only binary computation-offloading decisions (pp. 6-7); transmit power and time slots come from convex optimization (p. 8), so learning acts above the physical layer.
notes: Excluded as above_phy. The DNN actor outputs only the binary offloading decisions of the devices to the AAV or HAP edge servers (p. 6: "The output of the module are multiple discrete candidate offloading decisions"); transmit power, time slots and CPU frequencies are then obtained by convex optimization and linear programming (p. 8: "we can obtain the optimal value of MTD transmission power by solving P4"), so no learned component sets a physical-layer quantity. Task offloading is the example listed under above_phy; no_learning could also be argued because the physical-layer allocation is classical. The abstract (p. 1) frames the work as computation offloading and resource allocation for edge computing.
